description: I like playing chess and I am interested in space exploration, I want you to join the team so we can work together to make an app about NASA's discarded items. In the app we will explain what the items are and what their functions are. We would be very happy if you join.
summary: Lost Space Vault is an app about NASA abandoned but not forgotten manmade items left on the Moon and Mars. From Eagle's Descent Stage to  Shepard's Golf Balls and much more! It includes information directly from NASA's 2012 Catalogue of Manmade Material on the Moon with 3D fascinating models of each! It reminds us of what is left behind and how we can use it for future missions.
details: It gives information about 18 different manmade items left on the Moon and Mars. It has a working 3D model of all the 18 items and gives details like location, what it was used for, and dimensions. We want our app to help others know how we could reuse it and lower costs. We used Base44 to design the app and Claude for the 3D models by taking information from the NASA's 2012 Catalogue of Manmade Material on the Moon. The project is creative because of the use of 3D models and 18 different manmade items. We focused on giving more information about the items, whether they were deliberately placed there or not, and whether they were placed there for any scientific use or not.
dataRefs: NASA's 2012 Catalogue of Manmade Material on the Moon
